Records.description: Three-loop PL bare scalar (all unit propagator powers) imported from arXiv:2111.13595 ancillary i2m IBP reduction (sector 12678; 19 master(s)). One off-shell external leg P^2 = MM, the other external legs on-shell massless; single-scale (x-free, immune to the t/u variable choice). D=4-2eps all-unit-power scalar, leading 1/eps^3. Stored in the e^{+i pi} branch (library-native). Its value coincides with the massless kite/spectacle propagator known from Kompaniets-Panzer (arXiv:1705.06483) and Gehrmann et al. (arXiv:1004.3653) cited in this entry's Records; this import provides the FIRST machine-readable, crit-3-validated Laurent series (the home previously held only symbol-level proposals plus literature citations, with no stored series).
Records.verifiedVia: criterion-3: anc i2m bare-scalar value == library STIntegrate-native(home graph) EXACT (max|diff|=0) at 3 Euclidean points across delta-free orders eps^lead..0 (the stored truncation; not validated beyond eps^0). STIntegrate-native ran on the cluster (Nereid) via the HyperIntica backend (HyperFLINT dylib absent; the SubTropica backends integrate the same Symanzik integrand and cross-check); MZV ginsh-reduction on the Mac; single cluster-STIntegrate + Mac-ginsh hybrid witness. STVerify N/A (timelike e^{+i pi} branch-resolution gap, same as the existing symbol-proposal records in this entry).

Records.description: Three-loop massless off-shell two-point self-energy obtained from the two-loop master by replacing the central (k-q) propagator with a one-loop bubble insertion (Q and Q-s with s=q-k, two parallel propagators). The integral is reduced loop-by-loop: a one-loop self-energy in Q gives a shifted exponent for the central edge of the master, yielding a closed-form expression involving Gamma functions, cos(pi*D), and a single 3F2 hypergeometric of unit argument. Result agrees with Hathrell, Eq. (8.13).

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator integral, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{0 - 3 eps} * Cfull^3 * anc[pInt[3,5]]: the KP G-scheme period series (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g4: IRR-rearranged auxiliary p-integral (NOT a phi^4 self-energy); 2L-V=0; I ~ (p2)^{-3 eps}; log-divergent, dimensionless. p2 = -MM > 0 : the spacelike (mostly-plus) external invariant, = minus the package mostly-minus Euclidean MM (MM<0; conventions.md L918-924). value = (p2)^{0 - 3 eps} * (dimensionless p2=1 form) is REAL for p2>0 (KP G-scheme). At the pySD anchor MM=-1, i.e. p2=+1, the scale factor is 1, reproducing the anchored period; the i*pi tower appears only on continuation to timelike p2<0 (MM>0). NOT computed by STIntegrate/HyperFLINT (a HyperInt reimplementation; using it to validate the ancillary HyperInt value would be circular).
